# --- Block backend and legacy private endpoints ---

Disallow: /wp-admin/

Disallow: /wp-login.php
# HTML account/utility pages are not disallowed for regular search crawlers.
# They emit noindex headers/meta; blocking them here would prevent crawlers
# from seeing those directives and can leave stale URLs indexed as
# "blocked by robots.txt".

# --- Block thin/duplicate/utility pages ---
Disallow: /cgi-bin/
Disallow: /xmlrpc.php
Disallow: /?s=
Disallow: /cart/
Disallow: /checkout/
Disallow: /my-account/

# --- Google News ---
# Googlebot-News is the token for the Google News product (news.google.com
# and the Google News app). Google builds that feed on its own and was
# listing quote, price, puzzle and legal pages as stories; these rules keep
# it to articles. Google Search does not read this group: Googlebot follows
# "User-agent: *" above, so search indexing is unchanged.
# A named group replaces "*" for its token, so the generic list is mirrored.

# --- AI / LLM crawlers (explicit policy) ---
# Allow indexing of public editorial content. Mirrors the generic
# disallow list above so private and utility paths stay private from
# every bot, not just search engines.
#
# /admin* is intentionally NOT disallowed here for the same reason it is
# not disallowed in the User-agent: * block: middleware emits an
# X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow header on every /admin response, and a
# bot can only learn that header by being allowed to fetch the URL.
# Disallowing /admin in robots would freeze any historical index entry
# in place (robots.txt cannot deindex; only noindex can).
